svg.aria-label: How OpenSlime learns: evidence becomes a trial lesson that reaches only a challenger. A probe runs the same writer, skill and base twice, differing by one LESSONS line; reviewers see only A and B. The result is scored by VERIFY, then Critical, then Warning findings. You decide with a blind pick and a reveal; the lesson is adopted into the main brief or retired. OpenSlime’s own rules are tracked the same way.
